description: This file defines a custom web component 'openclaw-a2ui-host' using LitElement. It manages UI surfaces, handles actions, applies messages, and manages styles for a web-based UI framework related to OpenClaw. It imports external modules for lit, context, and theme management, and contains methods for event handling, rendering, and style updates.

classes.name: OpenClawA2UIHost
classes.description: A custom web component extending LitElement that manages UI surfaces, actions, and styles for the OpenClaw framework.

methods.name: connectedCallback
methods.description: Initializes event listeners, sets up the API, and synchronizes surfaces when the component is added to the DOM.

methods.name: disconnectedCallback
methods.description: Removes event listeners when the component is removed from the DOM.

methods.name: #makeActionId
methods.description: Generates a unique ID for actions.

methods.name: #setToast
methods.description: Displays a temporary toast message with specified text, type, and duration.

methods.name: #handleActionStatus
methods.description: Handles status updates for actions based on events.

methods.name: #handleA2UIAction
methods.description: Processes user actions, creates action objects, and communicates with native handlers.

methods.name: applyMessages
methods.description: Processes an array of messages to update UI surfaces.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Clears all surfaces and resets the component state.

methods.name: #syncSurfaces
methods.description: Synchronizes internal surface list with the message processor.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the component's HTML, including status, toast, and surfaces.
